title: JavaScript Minifier

instructions.title: How to use JavaScript Minifier

steps.title: Paste or upload your JavaScript code
steps.description: Paste your JavaScript source code into the editor. Supports ES6+, ES2024, JSX, and modern syntax including arrow functions, async/await, and optional chaining.

steps.title: Choose minification or beautification mode
steps.description: Select 'Minify' to compress code for production — removes whitespace, shortens variables, and eliminates dead code. Or select 'Beautify' to expand and indent minified code for readability.

steps.title: Configure compression level and options
steps.description: Adjust compression from basic (whitespace removal) to aggressive (variable renaming, function inlining, tree shaking). Enable source map generation for production debugging.

steps.title: Copy or download the optimized output
steps.description: Review the compression ratio (typically 30-70% size reduction), then copy the minified code or download the .min.js file with optional source maps.

troubleshooting: Syntax errors after minification: Ensure your code has no ES6+ features unsupported by the target — check for trailing commas or optional chaining
Output breaks functionality: Try lower compression level — aggressive variable renaming can conflict with eval() or dynamic property access
Source maps not working: Verify the source map URL comment is preserved in the minified output
Large file slow to process: Files over 1MB may take a few seconds — split into smaller modules if needed
Beautifier not indenting correctly: Check for mixed tabs/spaces in the original code and select consistent indentation settings
